material_finding: Physical GRID10 v2 repairs the v1 concurrency and stale-packet proof gaps, but source-bound packet metadata and even exact source-bound execution are not a general proof that a future model inference consumed the exact declared S1 representation. Packet freshness, source execution identity, and model-input consumption causality are three different evidence classes and must remain separate in Trigger-2 training/evaluation.

E1_PACKET_FRESHNESS.question: Does the packet name the currently admissible generation/epoch/digest and fail closed on stale or forged identity?

E2_PRODUCER_EXECUTION_IDENTITY.question: Was the exact reviewed producer source executed at the bound clean repository identity?
E2_PRODUCER_EXECUTION_IDENTITY.sufficient_for: exact-source producer component runtime claims only after accepted receipt

E3_CONSUMED_INPUT_CAUSALITY.question: Can the exact bytes/serialization that causally entered the cognitive/model computation be bound to the claimed S1 snapshot and output receipt?
E3_CONSUMED_INPUT_CAUSALITY.sufficient_for: required before model/J-Space causal consumption credit

hypothesis: For the deterministic synthetic GRID10 v2 harness, exact source binding plus the explicit read transaction can be sufficient to establish the harness's own packet-construction path at component scope, because the child process constructs its packet directly from the local snapshot object produced by ro_snapshot. This still does not transfer to a model-backed Xeno path unless the exact rendered/model input bytes and model-call identity are bound downstream.
counterhypothesis: Exact source binding alone could be treated as consumed-snapshot attestation for all later Xeno cognition, because the reviewed code is expected to pass the snapshot into the model. This is rejected as a general rule: loader/renderer/model-call substitutions, preprocessing drift, post-read mutation, or a model call that never receives the claimed bytes can preserve source and packet metadata while breaking causal input identity.

positive_behavior: accept exact-current packet metadata as packet freshness only when deterministic gates and provenance match
distinguish exact producer execution from proof of exact model-input consumption
request or preserve an input/render/model-call attestation when a claim depends on model/J-Space causal consumption
keep runtime component credit bounded to the evidence actually observed
hard_negatives: packet generation epoch digest all match, but the model consumed a different serialized snapshot
producer source hash matches, but a renderer silently reordered or dropped fields before inference
packet declares the correct snapshot digest, but output was produced from cached local state from an earlier call
model output is causally valid for a current snapshot, but the packet carries a forged digest authored after inference
ten physical processes pass concurrency proof, therefore full HCU or J-Space model causality is claimed
a clean exact-source runtime receipt is treated as training or canonical-semantics credit
